folders.delete_body_many: The label "{name}" is taken off its {count} items. The items stay in your vault.
folders.delete_body_one: The label "{name}" is taken off its item. The item stays in your vault.
folders.done_delete: The folder was taken off {count} items.
folders.done_failed: {count} could not be changed and still have the old folders.
folders.done_move: The folders of {count} items were changed.
folders.done_rename: The folder was renamed on {count} items.
folders.done_skipped: {count} cannot be changed now (read only, refused or in conflict) and were left as they are.
folders.done_stopped: The vault locked, so the change stopped. Do it again to change the rest.
folders.empty: No folders yet. Open an item, choose Edit and put it in a folder.
folders.error.folder_bad_character: A folder name cannot hold control characters, line breaks, direction marks or invisible spaces.
folders.error.folder_duplicate: The item is in that folder already (names that differ only in capital letters are the same folder).
folders.error.folder_empty: Type a name for the folder.
folders.error.folder_too_long: A folder name can be at most 64 characters long.
folders.error.folder_too_many: An item can be in at most {max} folders.
folders.gone: This folder is not open any more. Folders are opened again from the list of folders after the vault was locked.
folders.gone_link: Go to the list of folders
folders.intro: A folder is a label inside each item, encrypted with it. An item can be in several folders. A folder with no items does not exist.
folders.merge_body: There is a folder named "{to}" already. The items in "{from}" are added to it, and "{from}" goes.
folders.move.many_help: The folders you choose are added to each item. The folders the items are in already stay.
folders.picker.help: Choose a folder below or type a new name. An item can be in up to {max} folders.
folders.picker.label: Folders
folders.pin_full: You can pin at most 20 folders. Unpin one first.
folders.title: Folders
